summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser and its tests; nothing committed. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier) and SHACLPathError, following the seven-step procedure in the spec. Added test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with valid/invalid parametrized cases, a non-node input test, a Literal TypeError test, and a graph-unchanged check. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (41 tests). mypy, black, and isort are not installed in the prepared venv and were not run, so type-check and formatting are unverified; lines are under 88 columns by awk check. Possible mypy warn_unreachable flag on the non-node isinstance guard, since the parameter is annotated as Node.
